Three days ago: Monday. So one day ago would be Thursday (since Monday + 1 day is Tuesday, but wait, wait. Wait, no. Wait, if three days ago was Monday, then each day forward adds a day. Let me think again.

Wait, if three days ago was Monday, then today is three days after Monday. Wait, no. If three days ago was Monday, then each day from then to now is adding a day. So:

Two days ago: Tuesday

One day ago: Wednesday

Today: Thursday
